title: GARRET: Generative Feedback for Region Retrieval in Visual Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation over visually rich documents requires evidence at a finer granularity than entire pages. Existing visual retrievers typically index or return full pages, whereas training region-level retrievers often requires costly query-to-region annotations or noisy model-generated labels. We introduce GARRET, a region-retrieval framework trained from (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback. A shared context-preserving retriever produces page and region multi-vector representations. During training, their retrieval scores define a soft routing distribution over candidate region crops. An auxiliary vision-language model attends to each crop separately, aggregates crop-specific contexts using the routing weights, and predicts the question followed by the answer under a next-token prediction objective. translated_title: GARRET：面向视觉文档区域检索的生成式反馈
translated_abstract: 在视觉内容丰富的文档上进行多模态检索增强生成，需要比整页更细粒度的证据。现有的视觉检索器通常索引或返回完整页面，而训练区域级检索器往往需要代价高昂的查询-区域标注或带有噪声的模型生成标签。我们提出GARRET，一个通过可微生成式反馈、从（页面、问题、答案）三元组训练的区域检索框架。一个共享的上下文保持检索器生成页面和区域的多向量表示。在训练过程中，其检索得分定义了候选区域裁剪图块上的软路由分布。一个辅助视觉语言模型分别关注每个图块，利用路由权重聚合图块特定的上下文，并在下一词预测目标下先预测问题再预测答案。通过路由分布回传的梯度为查询条件分配信用（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: GARRET通过可微的生成式反馈，仅利用（页面、问题、答案）三元组即可训练出视觉文档的区域级检索器，无需昂贵的区域标注。
en_tdlr: GARRET trains region-level retrievers for visual documents using only (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback, eliminating the need for costly region-level annotations.
